descriptions: Untrusted REE-controlled obj_id_sz (params[0].memref.size) directly controls the TEE_MemMove length. There is no effective upper-bound/bounds check on obj_id_sz before allocating/copying, enabling resource exhaustion and potentially unsafe behavior if allocation/copy semantics are stressed by large sizes.
why_not_categories: Not Unencrypted Data Output: this copies from shared memory into private memory, not secret/private data to an untrusted-visible region.
Not Direct Usage of Shared Memory: the issue is not trusting shared content across a check/use boundary; it is using an untrusted length without a bound.
Not other: fits the definition of unchecked tainted size reaching a memory operation.
